prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production scenic background for a Chinese xianxia idle game's school comparison stage, NOT a user interface mockup.
Primary request: a beautifully painted quiet cultivation pavilion interior, with strong spatial depth and broad uncluttered foreground floor where separate sword-stand and talisman-desk sprites will later be placed by game code.
Scene/backdrop: a weathered open-sided Daoist wooden hall inside a mountain retreat; distant misty blue mountains and a waterfall glimpsed through tall lattice windows; dark carved beams framing the upper corners, sparse bamboo at the outer edges, one small warm lantern on each far side. No readable signs.
Style/medium: premium Chinese fantasy game environment illustration, rich tactile painterly realism, restrained ink-like edges, matching detailed jade-green xianxia landscape art rather than a flat vector image or 3D screenshot.
Composition/framing: very wide landscape about 2:1, frontal slightly elevated eye-level perspective. The bottom 65 percent is an uninterrupted elegant blue-green stone floor with believable perspective and soft side lighting. Leave large empty foreground landing areas around 18 percent and 62 percent of the image width for composited objects; quiet darker areas around 36 percent and 83 percent for live DOM captions. Architectural detail recedes toward the middle upper half; depth must remain visible. Do not paint the sword, talisman, any tabletop, or pedestals in these empty landing zones.
Lighting/mood: tranquil early morning, cool atmospheric jade/indigo ambient light from the windows, small warm lantern accents at far edges; floor and central background medium-dark for clear pale text, crisp but not harsh, no large yellow region. An inviting place for choosing a path, not a battle or victory.
Color palette: ink blue, dark jade, muted teal stone, warm aged brass at tiny accents. Preserve subtle material and light differences; avoid a featureless green wash.
Text: none.
Constraints: environment art only, opaque background. No characters, no people, no swords, no talisman desks or scroll props, no magic circles, no floating particles, no active spells, no icons, no UI boxes, no borders, no numbers, no letters, no logos, no watermark. Do not imply a new unlocked realm. Keep all four edges calm for clean cropping in an actual desktop game stage.
